name: MGB
recent: MGB 近期持续进行股份回购，并在2026年10月底至11月初有多笔董事及大股东在闭市期内的交易申报。公司尚未发布最新季度业绩，但上一季度（2026年6月30日止）营收同比下滑6.8%，净利则同比增长12.1%。
notable: 公司于2026年10月至11月期间多次进行股份回购。
集团执行主席 Tan Sri Dato' Sri Ir. (Dr.) Lim Hock San 及集团董事经理 Datuk Wira Lim Hock Guan 在闭市期内增持公司股份。
risks: 董事及大股东在闭市期内进行股份交易，可能涉及利益冲突或市场信心考量。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度营收为2.017亿令吉，同比下滑6.8%，环比下滑4.0%；净利为1334.7万令吉，同比增长12.1%，环比下滑5.6%；净利率为6.6%，低于上一季度的6.7%。

recent_en: MGB has been actively conducting share buybacks recently, with several director and substantial shareholder dealings during the closed period reported from late October to early November 2026. The company has not yet released its latest quarterly results, but in the previous quarter (ended 30 June 2026), revenue fell 6.8% year-on-year while net profit rose 12.1%.
notable_en: The company conducted multiple share buybacks between October and November 2026.
Group Executive Chairman Tan Sri Dato' Sri Ir. (Dr.) Lim Hock San and Group Managing Director Datuk Wira Lim Hock Guan acquired shares during the closed period.
risks_en: Directors and substantial shareholders traded shares during the closed period, which may raise conflict-of-interest or market-confidence considerations.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR201.7 million, down 6.8% year-on-year and 4.0% quarter-on-quarter; net profit was MYR13.35 million, up 12.1% year-on-year but down 5.6% quarter-on-quarter; net margin was 6.6%, lower than 6.7% in the previous quarter.
